title: ISO 42001 Annex A Control A.7 – Data for AI Systems
objective: Ensure organisations recognise the pivotal role and impacts of data throughout the entire lifecycle of AI systems, including application, development, provision, and usage.
description: ISO 42001 Annex A Control A.7 emphasises the importance of data for AI systems, focusing on defining, documenting, and implementing data management processes throughout their life cycles to ensure data quality, provenance, and preparation.

title: Data for Development and Enhancement of AI System

subsections.heading: Defining and Documenting Processes for AI System Development
subsections.content: Establish and document data management processes covering acquisition to disposal, addressing privacy, security, and representativeness of training data.

subsections.heading: Contribution of Effective Data Management to AI System Enhancement
subsections.content: Effective data management ensures data integrity, representativeness, and transparency, improving AI performance and reliability.

subsections.heading: Challenges in Implementing Data Management Processes
subsections.content: Challenges include data bias, quality assurance, and compliance with evolving regulations due to the complexity and volume of AI system data.

subsections.heading: Considerations for Acquiring Data for AI Systems
subsections.content: Identify data categories, quantities, sources (internal, purchased, open), and evaluate data rights and privacy implications for PII.

subsections.heading: Documenting the Selection of Data Used in AI Systems
subsections.content: Record data source characteristics, subject demographics, previous uses, and document privacy and security compliance.

subsections.heading: Implications of Data Source and Quality on AI System Performance
subsections.content: High-quality, representative data enhances reliability and accuracy, while poor-quality data leads to biased or inaccurate outcomes.

title: Quality of Data for AI Systems

subsections.heading: Defining Requirements for AI System Data Quality
subsections.content: Define criteria such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, and relevance that data must meet before use.

subsections.heading: Strategies for Meeting Data Quality Requirements
subsections.content: Implement data validation, cleaning, audits, normalization, and error detection to ensure data meets quality standards.

subsections.heading: Impact of Data Quality on AI System Reliability
subsections.content: Reliable AI outputs depend on high-quality data; poor-quality data increases risk of flawed decisions and bias.

subsections.heading: Importance of Data Provenance
subsections.content: Ensure traceability and accountability by recording data origins, processing history, and responsible parties.

subsections.heading: Processes to Document Throughout Data and AI Lifecycle
subsections.content: Document collection, transformation, usage, storage, source details, and rationale for changes for audit trails.

subsections.heading: Impact of Data Provenance on Transparency and Accountability
subsections.content: Detailed provenance records support regulatory compliance and ethical AI by enabling clear explanations of AI decisions.

subsections.heading: Defining Criteria for Data Preparation Methods
subsections.content: Establish criteria ensuring data integrity, consistency, and relevance based on AI model nature and operational goals.

subsections.heading: Documenting Data Preparation Methods
subsections.content: Detail techniques such as cleaning, normalization, labeling, encoding, and rationale for method selection.

subsections.heading: Addressing Common Data Preparation Challenges
subsections.content: Manage missing data, mitigate bias, and maintain quality using robust methods and tools.

subsections.heading: Leveraging ISMS.online for Effective Data Preparation
subsections.content: Use platform tools to streamline preparation, documentation, and compliance with ISO 42001 standards.
